description.value:
Trigger You begin to draw an Overflow effect that would advance your Reckoning.

Duration constant

You learn precisely what the next stage will take from you — which fact, which skill, which capability, or exactly what a Major Reckoning will cost. You may decline to draw and lose nothing. Once per day, having seen it, you may instead choose a different toll of the same stage: the ledger is indifferent to which specific thing it takes.

cinderfall.incomplete: Previewing and re-rolling which specific toll a Reckoning stage takes -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
